requirements.title: Local Command Execution
requirements.description: The system SHALL execute commands directly on the host filesystem when configured in local mode.
requirements.rationale: Provides lightweight execution environment for development and testing without Docker dependency.
acceptance_criteria: System creates isolated workspace directory per execution
Command inherits environment variables from request
requirements.test_strategy: Integration test with known commands

requirements.title: Workspace Isolation
requirements.description: The system SHALL create a unique, isolated workspace directory for each execution using the execution ID.
requirements.rationale: Prevents cross-contamination between executions and enables audit trail correlation.
acceptance_criteria: Execution ID used for directory name
requirements.test_strategy: Execute multiple concurrent requests, verify separate workspaces

requirements.title: Execution ID Generation
requirements.description: The system SHALL generate a unique execution ID using UUID v4 if not provided by client.
requirements.rationale: Ensures every execution has a unique identifier for audit trail correlation.
acceptance_criteria: If execution_id provided in request, use it
If execution_id empty, generate UUID v4
ID returned in all execution events
requirements.test_strategy: Test with client-provided ID, empty ID (auto-generation), and invalid ID rejection

requirements.title: Output Streaming
requirements.description: The system SHALL stream stdout and stderr from executing commands in real-time to the client.
requirements.rationale: Provides immediate feedback and enables monitoring of long-running executions.
acceptance_criteria: Stdout lines streamed as EventStdout events
Stderr lines streamed as EventStderr events
requirements.test_strategy: Execute command with known output, verify all lines received

requirements.title: File Injection
requirements.description: The system SHALL write all files from the execution request to the workspace directory before command execution.
requirements.rationale: Enables self-contained execution with all required input files.
acceptance_criteria: File content matches request bytes exactly
requirements.test_strategy: Inject known files, verify content and paths

requirements.title: Path Traversal Prevention
requirements.description: The system SHALL reject any file paths that attempt directory traversal (e.g., ../, absolute paths).
requirements.rationale: Prevents security vulnerability and data contamination outside workspace.
acceptance_criteria: Paths resolved relative to workspace only
Execution fails immediately on invalid path
requirements.test_strategy: Attempt injection with ../etc/passwd and /etc/passwd, verify rejection

requirements.title: Artifact Collection
requirements.description: The system SHALL collect files matching retain patterns using glob matching after command execution.
requirements.rationale: Enables retrieval of execution results for analysis and archival.
acceptance_criteria: Glob patterns evaluated against workspace contents
Matching files streamed as FileChunk events
File count reported in completion event
requirements.test_strategy: Create files matching patterns, verify all matches collected and non-matches ignored

requirements.title: Workspace Cleanup
requirements.description: The system SHALL remove workspace directory after execution if no retain patterns specified.
requirements.rationale: Prevents disk space exhaustion from temporary workspaces.
acceptance_criteria: If retain empty, workspace deleted after execution
Cleanup failure logged but doesn't fail execution
requirements.test_strategy: Execute without retain (verify cleanup) and with retain (verify preservation)

requirements.title: Execution Event Correlation
requirements.description: The system SHALL include the execution ID in every execution event streamed to the client.
requirements.rationale: Enables correlation of all events back to the initiating request and audit entry.
acceptance_criteria: execution_id field populated in every ExecutionEvent
ID consistent across all events for single execution
ID matches request execution_id or generated UUID
requirements.test_strategy: Execute and verify all events contain same execution ID

requirements.title: Timestamping
requirements.description: The system SHALL include Unix epoch timestamp in every execution event.
requirements.rationale: Provides chronological record of execution activities.
acceptance_criteria: timestamp field populated in every ExecutionEvent
Timestamps monotonically increasing (or equal) within execution
requirements.test_strategy: Verify timestamps present and chronological

requirements.title: Command Traceability
requirements.description: The system SHALL log the actual command executed, including any overrides applied.
requirements.rationale: Audit trail must show what actually executed, not just what was requested.
acceptance_criteria: Overridden command logged if override applied
Execution ID links command to events
requirements.test_strategy: Execute with command override, verify both original and actual command logged

requirements.title: Execution Completion Recording
requirements.description: The system SHALL report execution completion with exit code, runtime, and files collected.
requirements.rationale: Provides definitive record of execution outcome.
acceptance_criteria: Runtime in seconds calculated and reported
requirements.test_strategy: Execute successful command (verify exit code 0) and failing command (verify non-zero)

requirements.title: Mode Selection
requirements.description: The system SHALL support selection of executor mode via configuration or command-line flag.
requirements.rationale: Enables deployment-specific execution strategies.
acceptance_criteria: Valid modes: local, docker, file-server, scheduler
requirements.test_strategy: Start with each valid mode, attempt invalid mode and verify error

requirements.title: Workspace Base Configuration
requirements.description: The system SHALL allow configuration of workspace base directory.
requirements.rationale: Enables control over workspace location for disk space and access control.
acceptance_criteria: Empty value defaults to system temp directory
requirements.test_strategy: Configure custom workspace, verify usage

requirements.title: Configuration Validation
requirements.description: The system SHALL validate configuration at startup and fail fast on errors.
requirements.rationale: Prevents operation with invalid configuration.
requirements.test_strategy: Provide invalid config, verify rejection

requirements.title: Command Execution Isolation
requirements.description: The system SHALL execute commands with the same user permissions as the server process.
requirements.rationale: Local mode does not provide additional isolation; documentation and access control required.
requirements.test_strategy: Execute command, verify process owner

requirements.title: Path Sanitization
requirements.description: The system SHALL sanitize all file paths to prevent directory traversal.
requirements.rationale: Prevents unauthorized file access or modification.
requirements.test_strategy: See REQ-FILE-LOC-002

requirements.title: Execution Errors
requirements.description: The system SHALL report execution errors via ExecutionError event with descriptive message.
requirements.rationale: Client must know when execution fails and why.
requirements.test_strategy: Execute non-existent command, inject file to read-only location, verify error events

requirements.title: Graceful Degradation
requirements.description: The system SHALL continue artifact collection even if command exits with non-zero code.
requirements.rationale: Partial results may still be valuable for diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria: Non-zero exit code doesn't prevent artifact collection
Completion event includes actual exit code
requirements.test_strategy: Execute failing command, verify artifacts collected

requirements.title: Test Traceability
requirements.description: The system SHALL provide mechanism to trace tests back to requirements.
requirements.rationale: Enables validation documentation and requirement coverage analysis.
requirements.test_strategy: Review test codebase for metadata

requirements.title: Test Boundaries
requirements.description: Tests SHALL validate that commands are called correctly without executing actual computations.
requirements.rationale: Per CLAUDE.md: Boundaries for most testing should limit to 'Are we calling the correct thing'
acceptance_criteria: Black box tests verify file content requirements
Actual computation not tested (external to Hermes)
requirements.test_strategy: Mock command execution where appropriate
